scope: Exclusion-only semantic review of frozen definitions against existing evidence; no inference, no new examples, no modifications to plan or code.

decision_threshold.high_confidence_near_duplicate: Definition-level collision of a concrete incident signature: a distinctive combination of antecedent/condition, affected object/scope and active requested action. This is a conservative exclusion under the frozen-case protocol, not a claim that an unwritten generated message is a textual duplicate.
decision_threshold.broader_task_overlap: Only shared task, service, skill, symptom family or policy intent, with insufficient distinctive event configuration to infer a near-duplicate. These are not automatic exclusions.
decision_threshold.authorship: The plan was authored and frozen before this exclusion audit without reading old messages. Similarity alone does not prove benchmark-derived authorship, deliberate leakage or overfitting.
decision_threshold.preflight: Known resource-probe scenarios are reserved for train; a match in train is permitted by that reservation. None of the identified preflight matches crosses into validation/test.

interpretation_limits: This reviews short scenario definitions, not the five generated messages. Generation can add or remove distinctive context, so final text-level and semantic audits remain mandatory.
No model predictions, errors, accuracy or selection outcomes were used.
References are identifiers only; no old message text, rationale, suggested replacement or rewritten scenario is reproduced.
Broader-overlap links are illustrative semantic links, not an exhaustive catalogue of all possible generic matches.
Unflagged definitions are eligible for generation, not certified free of all future leakage and not accepted training data.
The existing500 remain known regression evidence; this exclusion review does not make them a virgin generalization test.
Confidence is qualitative reviewer judgment about scenario resemblance, not a statistical probability.
